name: 01-git-head-status.sh
command: bash -c git rev-parse HEAD; echo "---STATUS---"; git status --short | head -n 30; echo "---BRANCH---"; git branch --show-current; echo "---LOG3---"; git log --oneline -3

name: 03-structural-checks.sh
command:
bash -c python3 - <<PY
import json, sys
errs = []
def check(cond, msg):
    print(("PASS " if cond else "FAIL ") + msg)
    if not cond: errs.append(msg)
s = json.load(open("docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r4/schema-draft.json"))
check(s["draft_version"] == "0.5.0", "schema version 0.5.0")
check(s["status"] == "DRAFT / NOT EFFECTIVE", "status DRAFT/NOT EFFECTIVE")
rr = next(f for f in s["fields"] if f["id"] == "RESPONSE_RATING")
pb = rr["structure"]["presence_branches"]
check(pb["discriminator"] == "scoreable_view", "presence discriminator is scoreable_view")
u, d = pb["dal_U_unscorable"], pb["dal_S_scoreable"]
check(u["required"] == ["unscorable_reason"], "Dal U requires unscorable_reason")
check(set(["F1","F2","F3","F4"]) <= set(u["forbidden"]), "Dal U forbids F1-F4")
check("unscorable_reason" in d["forbidden"], "Dal S forbids unscorable_reason")
check(set(["F1","F2"]) <= set(d["required"]), "Dal S requires F1+F2")
check("resolved" in d["F3_rule"] and "f3_gap" in d["F3_rule"] and "FORBIDDEN" in d["F3_rule"], "Dal S F3 conditional + gap")
check("applicability" in d["F4_rule"] and "f4_gap" in d["F4_rule"] and "FORBIDDEN" in d["F4_rule"], "Dal S F4 conditional + gap")
adj = rr["structure"]["adjudication"]
check("final_scoreable_view" in adj["requires"], "adjudication requires final_scoreable_view")
br = {c["when"]: c["then"] for c in adj["requires_conditional"]}
check("final_scoreable_view == scoreable" in br and "F1/F2" in br["final_scoreable_view == scoreable"], "final scoreable branch presence")
check("final_scoreable_view == unscorable_content" in br and "forbidden" in br["final_scoreable_view == unscorable_content"].lower(), "final unscorable branch forbids F1-F4")
check(adj["never_overwrites_raw_slots"] is True, "raw immutability kept")
f3 = next(f for f in s["fields"] if f["id"] == "F3")
check(any(c.get("field") == "f3_gap" for c in f3.get("requires_conditional", [])), "F3 conditional f3_gap")
f4 = next(f for f in s["fields"] if f["id"] == "F4")
conds = {c.get("field") for c in f4.get("requires_conditional", [])}
check({"inapplicability_reason", "f4_gap", "applicability_resolution"} <= conds, "F4 conditional trio")
for p in ["no_F1_F4_in_unscorable_branch","no_unscorable_reason_in_scoreable_branch","no_F3_value_without_resolved_criterion","no_F4_value_where_inapplicable","no_missing_F1_F2_in_scoreable_branch","no_final_without_explicit_final_scoreable_view"]:
    check(p in " ".join(s["prohibitions"]), f"prohibition {p}")
for p in ["no_contested_inside_resolved_reference","no_scoreability_or_F1_F4_in_layer_B_slots","no_F3_without_resolved_id_and_version","no_extra_adjudication_gate_on_two_explicit_unscorable","no_composite_score"]:
    check(p in " ".join(s["prohibitions"]), f"regression prohibition {p}")
lt = s["layer_timing"]
check(lt["response_rating"] == {"layer": "C", "timing": "post_evaluation"}, "layer/timing intact")
f5 = next(f for f in s["fields"] if f["id"] == "F5")
check("scoreable_view" not in f5["structure"]["slot_schema"], "F5 slot still clean (R3 regression)")
check("contested" in f5["structure"] and "contested" not in f5["structure"]["resolved_reference"]["fields"], "contested placement intact (R3 regression)")
check(next(f for f in s["fields"] if f["id"] == "F3")["criterion_ref"].get("binds") == ["criterion_id", "criterion_version"], "F3 binding intact (R2 regression)")
check("no additional adjudication" in s["scoreability_final_states"]["both_explicit_unscorable"], "6.2 intact (R2 regression)")
rows = s["applicability"]["rows"]
check(len(rows) == 12, "applicability rows == 12")
check(sum("(Layer C, post)" in r["field"] for r in rows) == 6 and sum("(Layer B, pre)" in r["field"] for r in rows) == 6, "layer rows 6+6")
f4row = next(r for r in rows if r["field"].startswith("F4 "))
check("applicability_resolution" in f4row.get("condition_note", ""), "F4 note covers conditional resolution")
blob = open("docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r4/schema-draft.json").read()
for bad in ["probably_benign","probably_concerning","clearly_benign","clearly_concerning","BLIND-","RI-DU-","RI-AM-"]:
    check(bad not in blob, f"no human-label/corpus content {bad!r}")
rub = open("docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r4/rubric-draft.md").read()
for term in ["8P", "final_scoreable_view", "f3_gap", "f4_gap", "applicability_resolution"]:
    check(term in rub, f"rubric covers {term}")
bc = open("docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r4/boundary-cases-r4.md").read()
check("B-7U" in bc, "boundary case B-7U present")
print("STRUCTURAL:", "ALL PASS" if not errs else f"{len(errs)} FAILURES")
sys.exit(1 if errs else 0)
PY

name: 04-prior-untouched.sh
command:
bash -c python3 - <<PY
import hashlib
ok = True
for pkg in ["E1b", "E1b-r1", "E1b-r2", "E1b-r3"]:
    n = 0
    for line in open(f"docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/{pkg}/run-outputs.sha256"):
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) != 2: continue
        exp, path = parts
        if path.endswith("run-outputs.sha256"): continue
        if "run-outputs.sh.stdout" in path: continue
        try:
            got = hashlib.sha256(open(path, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            print("MISSING", path); ok = False; continue
        n += 1
        if got != exp:
            ok = False; print("MODIFIED", path)
    print(pkg, f"{n} files checked")
print("PRIOR-INTOUCH:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
PY

name: 05-frozen-hashes.sh
command: bash -c python3 -c "import json,hashlib; man=json.load(open(\"results/dataset_audit/phase7e_preregistration_hash.json\")); lines=[f\"{p}:{hashlib.sha256(open(p,\"rb\").read()).hexdigest()}\" for p in sorted(man[\"protocol_files\"])]; comp=hashlib.sha256((chr(10).join(lines)).encode()).hexdigest(); print(\"composite:\",comp,\"match:\",comp==man[\"composite_protocol_hash\"])"; sha256sum dataset/pilot/multiturn/stimulus_dataset_v1.json; python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open(\"dataset/pilot/multiturn/stimulus_dataset_v1.json\")); print(\"items:\",len(d[\"records\"]),\"conditions:\",sum(len(r[\"conditions\"]) for r in d[\"records\"]))"; python3 -c "import hashlib; [print(f, len(open(f).read().splitlines()), hashlib.sha256(open(f,\"rb\").read()).hexdigest()) for f in [\"results/dataset_audit/phase7e_review_history.jsonl\",\"results/dataset_audit/phase7g_review_history.jsonl\"]]"

name: 06-diff-check.sh
command: bash -c git diff --check; echo "diff-check exit=$?"; git status --short | head -n 30; git diff -- .gitignore > docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r4/delivery.diff; echo "---DELIVERY.DIFF---"; cat docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r4/delivery.diff

name: 07-link-check.sh
command:
bash -c python3 -c "
import re, pathlib
e0=pathlib.Path(\"docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r4\")
ok=True
for f in sorted(e0.glob(\"*.md\")):
    txt=f.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")
    for m in re.finditer(r\"\]\(([^)#]+)(?:#[^)]*)?\)\", txt):
        tgt=m.group(1)
        if tgt.startswith(\"http\") or tgt.startswith(\"mailto:\") or tgt.startswith(\"#\"):
            continue
        p=(f.parent/tgt).resolve()
        exists=p.exists()
        print(f.name, tgt, \"OK\" if exists else \"MISSING\")
        if not exists: ok=False
print(\"link-check:\", \"PASS\" if ok else \"FAIL\")
"
